methods.name: RIM
methods.description: Modular computation units with individual default dynamics and sparse information flow, operating selectively based on relevance to improve robustness against noise and out-of-distribution observations.

methods.name: Consciousness Prior
methods.description: An inductive bias based on a sparse graphical model describing interactions between high-level variables, where each factor involves few variables capturing an independent mechanism, using attention to select a subset of high-level variables to interact during inference.

methods.name: Recurrent Entity Networks (EnTNet)
methods.description: A set of separate recurrent models whose hidden states store memory slots, which are either fixed by gates or modified via a simple RNN-style update.
